parent_objective: audit persistent protected-key source regression under PPO

forbidden_shortcuts: do not run more PPO before the audit
do not tune from private holdouts
do not ignore protected-key source deltas
hypothesis: M248 and M254 share a persistent PPO-gradient conflict: source-balanced PPO improves the broad M223 source while regressing the protected-key source, so the next repair needs a stronger lexicographic projection or hard protected-source constraint rather than another plain PPO smoke.
success_criteria: compare M248 and M254 protected-key and M223 source slopes
audit train-time source metrics against exact source deltas
classify whether the failure is base-specific or PPO-direction persistent
choose one bounded repair before more PPO
failure_criteria: run PPO before the audit decision
treat aggregate exact loss as sufficient despite protected-key regression

commands.name: m255_regression_audit
commands.command: Compare source-aware exact deltas and PPO metrics from M248 and M254, then select a bounded protected-source repair.

decision_rule: M255 should either admit a concrete protected-source projection/constraint implementation or reject PPO continuation until the source conflict is resolved.
next_blocker: Audit protected-key source regression and choose a bounded repair.
